# AHoosh

> AHoosh helps small and mid-size businesses across Europe get found and quoted by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI answers — through answer engine optimisation (AEO), AI readiness consulting, and self-serve products. Founded and run by Hesam Jafarzadeh, based in Belgrade, serving clients across Europe.

## Products (self-serve, buy directly)

- [The AEO Kit](https://ahoosh.ai/products/aeo-kit/): €49 one-time. A downloadable playbook, 40 fill-in templates, schema snippets, and 25 test prompts that show a business owner how to get mentioned by AI assistants, without hiring an agency.
- [AI Visibility Snapshot](https://ahoosh.ai/snapshot/): Free. A 12-point self-check, delivered by email, on whether a business is currently likely to be mentioned by AI assistants.
- [Free Growth Assessment](https://ahoosh.ai/assess/): Free. Self-scored business readiness, website/digital presence audit, and founder personality tests.
- [All products](https://ahoosh.ai/products/)
